output.explanation: NIG-UK invoiced GBP 2,240.00 for secondment services (NIG-UK:1900045238, ref 9000010783). NIG-SA booked GBP 2,128.00 (NIG-SA:ICV-SA-018834), a ratio of 0.95, and the line is explicitly described as net of 5% WHT. This matches the Saudi 5% withholding rate on services. The GBP 112.00 gap (USD 142.47 at the invoice-date rate) is withholding tax, not a keying or FX error.
output.recommended_action: NIG-SA should reclassify the GBP 112.00 withheld from the IC payable to WHT payable to the Saudi tax authority, and provide the WHT certificate to NIG-UK so NIG-UK can record it as a tax credit or expense against the receivable.
output.adjustment_description: NIG-SA: gross up the IC payable to NIG-UK to GBP 2,240.00 and record GBP 112.00 as WHT payable to ZATCA (or settle the IC balance net with a WHT certificate). NIG-UK: on receipt of the certificate, clear the GBP 112.00 residual receivable to WHT receivable or tax expense.
